fieldValues.title: Placement and sequence
fieldValues.moved_by: the filer: the session agent, analyst, scout or owner
fieldValues.needs: `Answers: SP-nn` naming a suggested or affirmed problem; the problem's domain and the group that holds it; a remedy where one fits; `Part of` an epic or story, with the sub-issue link (a new epic goes up as a proposed decision: *Escalating*); where work has steps, a sequence: a tracking issue whose sub-issues are its tasks, with `Blocked by` links where order matters; the issue carries `Answers:`, `Part of`, a `## Technical plan` and `## Acceptance`; proved with `clerk flow --chain`, `clerk care`, `clerk claim --dry-run` and `clerk board explain` A sequence answers four questions in its body (owner, 2026-10-25): is the goal recorded; is this a unit that can be completed; will we recognise a mistake (a measure with its baseline, the remedy's falsifier, the harm to watch); and do we know why each step is taken, and that we are not going in circles (the earlier attempts at the same thing, and what is different this time)? The aim is not a perfect system but knowing that we are improving, aware of the trade-off we are tuning.
fieldValues.theory: Confidence grades care, it does not gate work (decision 9d50126b, ratified 2026-10-24): an issue that names a suggested problem is worked in the care mode the policy gives; only no problem, or an unknown or set-aside one, stops it. A unit of work that must survive a closed chat is a sequence (clerk#197 is the first); the desk lists it until clerk#112 makes it a unit of its own.
gaps: No command suggests a placement (problem, domain, group, epic) for a new item (clerk#200).
`clerk queue` and the briefs do not read the care mode yet (clerk#156 phase 4).
fieldValues.remedies: clerk#200 (clerk place); clerk#156 phase 4; clerk#112; decision 9d50126b
